datasets.name: countries
datasets.note: Every country the Atlas ranks, with the region / income grouping used for colour and facets.

datasets.name: sectors
datasets.note: The nine classified HS92 sectors, in Atlas order. The page's categorical key: a sector's position here fixes its tone in every chart, so the same sector is the same colour on the treemap, the stack and the map. "Other" is dropped for the reason given at EXCLUDED_CODES — leaving it in would reserve a hue for a category no chart draws.

datasets.name: country-year
datasets.note: Complexity and macro panel, every ranked country, 1995-2023. The workhorse: trends, scatters, distributions, rankings, maps.

datasets.name: country-sector-year
datasets.note: Export value by sector for the cohort (VNM, THA, MYS, PHL, IDN, KOR), 1995-2023. Stacks, streams, marimekko, normalised shares. Excludes the "Other" sector (trade discrepancies and unclassified), so shares sum to classified exports.

datasets.name: world-sector-year
datasets.note: World exports by sector, 1995-2023. The backdrop a country's share is read against. Excludes the "Other" sector, matching country-sector-year so the two are comparable.

datasets.name: lead-product-year
datasets.note: VNM's export basket at HS92 4-digit, 2023. Treemaps, rankings, opportunity scatters, the product space overlay. Excludes trade discrepancies and unclassified commodities — see EXCLUDED_CODES.

datasets.name: lead-product-panel
datasets.note: VNM's twelve largest 2023 products traced back to 1995. Bump ranks, slopegraphs, small multiples, playback.

datasets.name: lead-thresholds
datasets.note: Atlas-computed percentiles of VNM's product-level distributions, by year and variable. Percentile fans and boxplots without re-deriving quantiles here.

datasets.name: product-space-nodes
datasets.note: HS92 4-digit products with their 2023 world trade value and complexity. Nodes for the proximity network, points for the PCI scatters.

datasets.name: product-space-edges
datasets.note: Proximity edges between HS92 4-digit products — the Atlas's own product-space graph. Matrix heatmaps and adjacency views.

datasets.name: lead-partners
datasets.note: Where VNM's exports go: the twelve largest destination markets, 1995-2023. Flows, routes, ranked bars, rank changes.
